title: Area-code org enumeration shard A pass 22

data.research_question: Which current public anarchist, anti-authoritarian, autonomous, Food Not Bombs, mutual-aid, collective and closely adjacent organizations are discoverable in shard-A NPAs 657, 660, 669 and 678?
data.method: Deterministic NPA shard-A enumeration with literal area-code queries, locality-derived searches, current-status verification, repository dedupe, historical-lead current-status checks, first-party and public-link-hub corroboration, and public organizational communications enumeration.
classification_rules: Use only current in-service U.S. geographic NPAs where integer(NPA) mod 3 == 0.
Historical directories and event reports are discovery seeds and do not establish current activity without fresh corroboration.
Area-code relations represent covered locality/discovery geography and do not assert telephone-number ownership unless a first-party organization source publishes that NPA itself.
Reuse canonical organization identities when already present; do not merge on name or handle similarity alone.
No private membership inference or person-level political/ideological affiliation profiling.

unresolved_leads: Santa Ana Food Not Bombs appears in historical directories but current independent organizational continuity was not mature enough for promotion in this pass

San Jose Food Not Bombs is already covered under 408 and remains an overlay-adjacent canonical identity; no duplicate organization was created
South Bay Mutual Aid / Silicon Valley DSA current relation expansion remains separate from this bounded materialization
